integrity: Finite face and lattice checks are exhaustive for the specified twelve-facet polytope; the mathematical proof separately supplies the total-unimodularity and toric-affine arguments.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies reduced singular support and generic transverse analytic types, not the nonreduced Jacobian scheme or analytic structure at component intersections. An unlocated equivalent specialization of general Gelfand–Tsetlin face theorems remains an originality risk.
title: Three conifold strata in the six-dimensional Gelfand–Tsetlin toric variety
